dedupe_keys.name: simulating changing traffic flow caused by new bus route in augsburg

description: Eduard published this NetLogo model of car and bus or tram traffic between Stadtbergen, Göggingen and Königsplatz in Augsburg, Germany. Agents travel from home to activity destinations and return, using cars or public transport. The model records travel time, waiting time and arrival satisfaction, which influence whether agents consider changing transport mode. Coverage is the stated Augsburg corridor; the source does not specify a surveyed demand year or a calibrated temporal resolution. It supports agent-based exploration of traffic changes associated with a new bus route. Behavioural responses remain model assumptions, and their accuracy was not independently assessed. Release 1.0.0 is available free through the CoMSES code repository and lists NetLogo. The release licence is CC-BY-4.0. Source code and model data were not downloaded or executed. Related resources include the CoMSES computational model library.
